title: PM condoles loss of lives in a mishap in Kutch, Gujarat
body_text:
The Prime Minister,  Shri Narendra Modi has expressed deep sorrow over the loss of lives in a mishap at Kutch, Gujarat. Shri Modi conveyed his condolences to the bereaved families and prayed for the speedy recovery of the injured.
The Prime Minister posted on X;
Distressed to hear about the loss of lives in a mishap in Kutch, Gujarat. I extend my condolences to those who have lost their loved ones in this tragedy. Praying for the swift recovery of the injured: PM @narendramodi
